question.prompt: A data set has a variance of 3. If every data value is multiplied by 2, what is the variance of the new data set?

solutions.explanation: Multiplying every data value by 2 also multiplies each deviation by 2, so the variance is multiplied by \(2^2=4\). Therefore, the new variance is \(3\times4=12\).
solutions.title: Scale the deviations
